issues.description: The helper conversion function fix_fix2float has inconsistent return types across the example program and the tests. In the example_program headers the function is declared to return float, while in the tests' math_fix.h it is defined/declared to return double. This discrepancy appears in both the template and solution repositories. Students reading the example program and the tests together will see two different signatures for the same utility function, which can cause confusion about the intended precision and type and may lead to subtle ABI/usage mismatches when comparing example code and test code.
issues.suggestedFix: Choose a single return type for fix_fix2float across all artifacts and make the declarations and definitions consistent. Preferably update the tests' math_fix.h (and any other test copies) to declare/define fix_fix2float as float to match example_program/src/math_fix.h and example_program/src/math_fix.c, or conversely change the example program to use double everywhere if higher precision is required. Apply the same change in both the template and solution repositories so examples and tests are consistent.
